name: ruff-fix
description: `/ruff-fix` command: run `ruff check --fix` and `ruff format` on changed (or named) Python files and surface remaining diagnostics. Also ships an opt-in PostToolUse hook (RUFF_FIX_ON_EDIT / RUFF_DIAGNOSTICS_ON_EDIT, both off by default). No LSP — pairs with ruff-lsp or pylsp for diagnostics.
